major_cooldowns.name: Goremaw's Bite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use Goremaw's Bite on cooldown right before Shadow Dance, or as your first cast inside the dance when Ancient Arts is down.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 426591 is the cast row; 426593 is the enemy bleed aura and 426592 is unobserved.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Dance only when Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is up, macro it with Shuriken Storm, and never press it during a global cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 185313 is the cast id; the 185422 twin is the self aura used in rule conditions.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send Shadow Blades with a Shadow Dance charge in hand so two dances fit inside it, and expect the second dance to run without Secret Technique.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 121471 carries both the cast and the self aura; the 279043 twin is not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pop your on-use trinket in the opener alongside Shadow Blades and keep it lined up with every later Shadow Blades window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use raid trinket named in the guide opener timeline; zero casts is normal for a player wearing different trinkets.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire Secret Technique as your first or second finisher inside Shadow Dance with Ancient Arts up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 280719 is the castable row the guide cites and the only one carrying the cooldown; 280720, 282449 and 1305994 share the name and cover the clone hits and the talent node, and the sampled parses recorded no Secret Technique casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Vanish on cooldown at low combo points and follow it straight into Shadowstrike to cycle your Deathstalker's Mark stacks.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1856 is the cast id; 11327 is the self aura.

rule.description: Open Shadowstrike into Goremaw's Bite then Shadow Dance
rule.action: Pull from Stealth with Shadowstrike, then Goremaw's Bite, then dance with Shadow Blades.

rule.description: Shadow Blades paired with Shadow Dance
rule.action: Hold Shadow Blades until a Shadow Dance charge is ready and press them in the same window.

rule.description: Bank a Shadow Dance charge for Shadow Blades
rule.action: Bank the Shadow Dance charge as Shadow Blades comes up so both dances land inside it.

rule.description: Shadowstrike as your builder inside Shadow Dance
rule.action: Build with Shadowstrike while Shadow Dance is up and keep Backstab for outside it.

rule.description: Eviscerate spent at full combo points
rule.action: Keep building until your combo points are full before you spend Eviscerate.

rule.description: Slice and Dice kept up all fight
rule.action: Spend your next Eviscerate the moment Slice and Dice drops.

rule.description: Eviscerate over Black Powder in Darkest Night
rule.action: Spend Darkest Night on Eviscerate instead of pressing Black Powder.
Follow every Vanish with Shadowstrike to put Deathstalker's Mark back on the boss.

rule.description: Vanish used at low combo points
rule.action: Spend your combo points into a finisher before you press Vanish.

rule.description: Backstab gives way to Shuriken Storm in AoE
rule.action: Build with Shuriken Storm instead of Backstab once extra targets are up.

rule.description: Black Powder as your finisher on packs
rule.action: Finish with Black Powder instead of Eviscerate once the pack is up.
